test_extension_points.py.note: radide/extension_points.py unit checks + ratchet: replacements of MainWindow methods by features may only go down (window_patches_baseline.json)

test_document_providers.py.note: characterization of the editors that open their own files (image editor ...): File > Open, reuse of the tab, unsaved state, Save All, closing question, Solution Explorer nodes, registration with extension_points

test_save_participants.py.note: characterization of Save All / closing-question participants without File > Open (firmware workbench, map editor, PE workbench: not saved by Save All)

test_solution_contributors.py.note: Solution Explorer contributors (databases, firmware, git colours, retro hints, web docks / preview, VB6): each runs once per refill, a failing one is logged

test_close_flow.py.note: closing the IDE: save question Cancel / agent tasks No keep it open and shut nothing down; Yes + Discard closes and runs every shutdown step once

test_lifecycle_events.py.note: project lifecycle events: template before open; after open / activate / reset / _update_actions each feature step runs the measured number of times; a failing step is logged

test_editor_events.py.note: designer / code editor / saving events: designer open steps, damaged form reported, form + project save steps, menus, language servers for new editors, VB6 properties, title, layout, no save question for a foreign project
